_comment: A self-contained prism-dispersion rig. Local coordinates are centered at [0,0,0] with the optical layout running right-to-left along X; the outer group moves the complete rig 3 m behind the moissanite along -Y.

objects._comment: The rig's local origin is its layout midpoint. center=[0,-3,0] places it 3 m behind the moissanite; all principal components remain on local Y=0 except the prism's small optical-path correction.
A 2 cm wide, 3 m tall slit at the right side. Reversed winding points its front-side 1-degree emission toward -X and the prism.
The prism is on the right of the origin, between the slit and screen. Its entry face is parallel to the slit-light plane; the small +Y offset preserves a practical dispersive path.
The photosensitive screen is centered at local [-3,0]. Its +45-degree Z rotation points the local +X front normal toward the moissanite at world [0,0].
